description: This PHP source file implements session management using a database backend with functions for session serialization, regeneration, creation, destruction, and garbage collection, along with a class for database connection handling.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class providing static methods for database-backed session management, including connection configuration, session read/write, destruction, garbage collection, and various session parameters.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Get or set the database driver used for session storage.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Get or set the database host for session storage.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Get or set the database user for session storage.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Get or set the database password for session storage.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Get or set the database name for session storage.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Get or set whether to persist the database connection.

methods.name: lifetime
methods.description: Get or set the session lifetime in seconds.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enable or disable debug mode for database connection.

methods.name: expireNotify
methods.description: Get or set the expiration notification callback.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Get or set the database table used for sessions.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Get or set whether to optimize the session table after cleanup.

methods.name: syncSeconds
methods.description: Get or set the synchronization interval in seconds.

methods.name: clob
methods.description: Get or set whether to use CLOBs for session data.

methods.name: dataFieldName
methods.description: Get or set the database field name for session data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Get or set the filter objects for session data processing.

methods.name: encryptionKey
methods.description: Get or set the encryption key used for crypted sessions.

methods.name: _conn
methods.description: Get the current database connection object.

methods.name: _crc
methods.description: Get or set the CRC checksum for session data.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initialize session handling by setting the custom session handler functions.

methods.name: _sessionKey
methods.description: Generate an encryption key for crypted sessions based on the session ID.

methods.name: _dumprs
methods.description: Debug function to output session record set as HTML.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configure database connection parameters for session storage.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Create or reuse a database connection for session handling.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the database connection (stub).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write session data to the database for a given session key.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Delete session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Garbage collect expired sessions from the database.
